# Carcavelos Daily Brief — 12 Nov 2026

**Solid 3.3m swell all day with light winds early—textbook autumn conditions.**

Morning is your sweet spot. Head out between 07:00–10:00 when winds stay light (15–18 km/h W) and the swell peaks at 2.4m with clean 7.6s periods. The bank will be responsive, and you'll have decent shape before the onshore kicks in.

By midday, WSW wind builds to 21+ km/h, chopping things up noticeably. The swell holds steady at 3.3m, but faces get messy—not worth the frustration unless you're desperate.

**Afternoon:** Wind stays elevated through sunset. Glassy windows close by 12:00.

**Tips:** Grab a mid-range shortboard—3.3m is meaty but manageable. Dawn patrol beats the crowds; locals will be thin before 08:00. Water's 17–20°C—springsuit handles it fine.
